def: to flaunt, i.e. raise a flag; figuratively, to be conspicuous

words.word: we will set up our banners

occurrences.text: We will rejoice in thy salvation, and in the name of our God we will set up our banners: the Lord fulfil all thy petitions.
words: we will set up our banners

occurrences.text: My beloved is white and ruddy, the chiefest among ten thousand.
